metric_semantics.daily_return_calendar: all B3 sessions in the evaluation window; zero return on sessions with no active family position
metric_semantics.portfolio_return: equal-notional mean of active instrument signal returns on the execution session
metric_semantics.month_concentration: largest positive calendar-month PnL divided by sum of positive calendar-month PnL; 1.0 if no positive month
metric_semantics.execution_window_assignment: trade belongs to the window of its execution date
metric_semantics.t_plus_1: next observed B3 trading session, not next calendar day
metric_semantics.eligibility_lookback: previous 60 B3 sessions excluding feature day t; at least 45 own observations
metric_semantics.security_class_interpretation: security_specification first whitespace-delimited token must be exactly ON, PN or UNT; this is a schema clarification only and not an economic change
metric_semantics.volume_shock_history: median traded value of the prior 20 observations that were themselves eligible under the frozen liquidity rule
metric_semantics.delayed_execution_robustness: same frozen signal from t executed at t+2 open and exited t+2 close; no signal recalculation and no hold change

survivor_policy.if_more_than_two_replicated_survivors_ra: descending min(discovery_sharpe_40bps, delayed_t_plus_2_sharpe_30bps, replication_sharpe_30bps), tie family_id ascending
